Intel Items.facts: Series F fundraising of $13 billion led by ICONIQ, valuing Anthropic at $183 billion post-money. Run-rate revenue reached over $5 billion by August 2025, up from approximately $1 billion at beginning of 2025. Company serves over 300,000 business customers.
Series E raised $3.5 billion at $61.5 billion post-money valuation. Round led by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Followed launch of Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code.

Intel Items.query_used: Anthropic most recent funding round 2024 2025 valuation
Intel Items.facts: Anthropic raised $65 billion in Series H funding at $965 billion post-money valuation on May 28, 2026. Round co-led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, Sequoia Capital, Capital Group, Coatue, D1 Capital Partners. Run-rate revenue crossed $47 billion earlier in May 2026. Round includes $15 billion of previously committed hyperscaler investments including $5 billion from Amazon. Anthropic ahead of OpenAI's $852 billion valuation from March 2026.

Anomalies.description: Working Hypothesis from Phase 1 stated Series H closed May 28, 2026 at $965 billion valuation. Multiple independent sources (TechCrunch, GIC, QIA, Digital Applied, Sudoflare) confirm this exact date, round designation, amount raised ($65 billion), and post-money valuation ($965 billion). No contradictory information found.

Prior funding round chronology: Series E ($61.5B valuation, March 2025) → Series F ($183B valuation, September 2025) → Series G ($380B valuation, February 2026) → Series H ($965B valuation, May 2026). This progression is confirmed across multiple sources with no gaps or contradictions.
